Content coverage

Sources you can trace.

85Captured official source pages
37Faculty and staff profiles
61Original document resource links
Coverage includes the major English and Chinese department menus and their discovered content pages. Linked university services, social media, original documents, and external sites remain external. News summaries retain links to the original announcements; event posters are preserved. This is a documented migration of the captured sources, not a claim that every historical or external page has been replicated.
Source differences and unavailable material

The English introduction’s history infographics contain dates that conflict with the university academic record. The redesigned history follows the university academic record (2000, 2004, 2013, 2023) and the 2024 merger announcement; original infographics remain available in the source collection.

One linked English news article returned HTTP 404: original URL. Its full content could not be migrated.

Three images from a legacy gallery host could not be retrieved and are identified as unavailable in the source collection. Some published faculty external-profile links appear to point to a different person; curated profiles use the original department profile and CV resources, while the source collection retains the published record.

Publication dates were not exposed for several announcements. No publication dates have been inferred from crawl dates or award years.

International materials dated 2019 and the 2022 seminar are labelled historical. Faculty contact details are kept with their source because listing and profile pages can differ.
